instructions: Presenting a monthly IT progress report to a company's management team. Calm, clear, confident and warm. Measured pace, natural pauses between sentences. Read numbers and dates clearly. No exaggeration.

lines.text: IT Department progress update, for the thirteenth of October, twenty twenty-six.
This month we tracked ten pieces of work.
Four are completed, three are in progress, and three are planned.
The highlights: WMS now runs on the Azure cloud, Watch Dog covers every SSG car park, and the new season portal is seventy-two percent done.
WMS moved to the Azure cloud from the twenty-second to the twenty-fourth of September.
Change request phase one went through user testing from the first to the seventh of October.
Once the users confirm the result, we deploy it to production.
Phase two has not started yet.
Also completed this month: the Central Reports server, for the car parks under Re Sustainability Solutions; the QMS enhancement; and the T twenty-four season portal, now rebranded as Res twenty-four.
The new season portal is seventy-two percent complete, on average.
The extension and rebrand, and the header and logo alignment, are done.
The DBS payment gateway and e-GIRO integration is at eighty percent, season sync at seventy, the five reports at fifty, and the credit and sale note upload to Nav at thirty.
Watch Dog monitoring is live at every SSG car park, and the rollout at Ehub has started, at ten percent.
On the O-P-Cs, UltraVNC will replace RealVNC, which needs a licence.
And at Ehub, Carbon Black will be uninstalled, as its licence has expired.
Next: collect the U-A-T results and deploy phase one, finish the payment gateway and season sync, and continue the Ehub rollout.
Then switch to UltraVNC, and remove Carbon Black.
